suggestions.rationale: The 'How it works' section on the homepage outlines the three core steps of using Cal.com. A concise, animated explainer video here would visually demonstrate the simplicity and efficiency of the scheduling process, immediately engaging visitors and clarifying the product's core value proposition without requiring them to read through text. This would enhance initial understanding and drive sign-ups.

suggestions.placement: Pricing page, above or within the plan comparison table
suggestions.rationale: The pricing page details distinct features for different user segments, particularly highlighting 'collaborative features' for Teams and Organizations. A video could visually articulate the added value of these premium plans, showcasing features like 'shared availability,' 'round-robin scheduling,' and 'routing forms.' This would help potential customers quickly understand which plan suits their needs and the ROI of upgrading, addressing the complexity of feature comparison.

suggestions.placement: Cal.ai section on the homepage or a dedicated Cal.ai feature page
suggestions.rationale: Cal.ai is introduced as 'Supercharged scheduling with AI-powered calls,' which represents a cutting-edge and potentially complex feature. An explainer video would be crucial to visually demonstrate how AI enhances scheduling, what 'AI-powered calls' entail, and the tangible benefits for users. This would demystify the technology, highlight its innovation, and drive adoption for this advanced offering.
